description: Submit a recreated video as an official HyperCodeMotion Studio gallery template, with the moderator code: the source link, its three compositions (cuadrado 1080×1080, vertical 1080×1920, horizontal 1920×1080) and the gallery card. It checks the source, the compositions and the card; if anything fails it returns accepted: false with the errors to fix and stores nothing. When accepted, the composition in the original's format is rendered with the Studio engine and compared with the original frame by frame; get_proposal_status returns that comparison. To send fixes after a comparison, call it again with the same code (up to 3 comparisons). Nothing is published until publish_template. A video that is already a template is not stored twice.

adminCode.description: The moderator code the user gave with the link. Required: only moderators can make gallery templates. Never repeat it back.

code.description: Only to send a revision after a comparison: the tracking code of the first proposal.

compositions.description: The three compositions, as objects or JSON-encoded strings.

url.description: Link of the source video's page, the same one given to get_recreation_brief.

name: propose_template
title: Propose a gallery template
